item.name: Main Map
item.bestFor: Open public fights, item spawns, movement practice, and landmark routes
item.landmarks: Shinjuku Station, Towers, Cafe, Mall, Sewers, stores, and smaller fight buildings
item.itemSpawns: Public items spawn around the map every 10 minutes, with surface and underground spawn dots shown on the Items page.
item.hazards: Most parts are destructible; the train station has a callable train hazard.
item.specialRules: Default public-server fighting area since V1.03.

item.name: Towers
item.bestFor: Roof access, vertical fights, billboard panels, and vending-machine routes
item.landmarks: Two 11-floor towers connected by a ninth-floor bridge, roof ladders, billboards, and editing panels on the fourth floors.
item.itemSpawns: Fire extinguishers on the roof and vending machines on the second-to-last floors.
item.hazards: Destroyed ladder sections can collapse the remaining handholds.
item.specialRules: Billboards were added to the towers in V1.44.

item.name: Shinjuku Station
item.bestFor: Item pickup routes, train hazard plays, center-map travel, and underground movement
item.landmarks: Primary and secondary entrances, rails, bathrooms, control room, leaderboards, and underground station paths.
item.itemSpawns: Trash cans, fire extinguishers, vending machines, and nearby underground item-spawn context.
item.hazards: Control panel can call a speeding train that heavily damages players on the rails.
item.specialRules: One control-panel button broadcasts through the station, while the other calls the train.

item.name: Graveyard
item.bestFor: Small-area fights and throwable gravestone routes near the arcade side of the map
item.landmarks: Cemetery on the left side of the arcade with bare trees and marked gravestones.
item.itemSpawns: Throwable gravestones.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible objects.
item.specialRules: Includes the Rika Throw gravestone added after V1.76.

item.name: Mansion
item.bestFor: Indoor fights, garage movement, and destructible building routes
item.landmarks: Two floors, side garage, small second-floor bedroom, staircase, shelves, and green-screen setup.
item.itemSpawns: Trash can by the bottom of the stairs.
item.hazards: Garage is easy to break in and out of during fights.
item.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.

item.name: Cafe
item.bestFor: Central fights, dummy practice, vending-machine use, and throwable-chair routes
item.landmarks: Open cafe near the middle plaza with a kitchen, second floor, counters, tables, and tall windows.
item.itemSpawns: Vending machine in the corner, fire extinguisher near the dummy, and throwable chairs.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond destructible cafe objects.
item.specialRules: Dummy always spawns near the entrance.

item.name: Unlicensed Studios
item.bestFor: Arcade machines, NEP card pickup, and routes between graveyard and mansion
item.landmarks: Building between the graveyard and mansion with arcade cabinets and a counter area.
item.itemSpawns: Garbage can, NEP card, and vending machine.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Arcade cabinets include Catch and Flight as playable machines.

item.name: Tze's
item.bestFor: Throwable-heavy indoor fights and routes between Shinjuku Station and Towers
item.landmarks: Restaurant between Shinjuku Station and the Towers with an interior menu board.
item.itemSpawns: One trash can, one fire extinguisher, 16 chairs, a vending machine, and a Nep behind the menu board.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond destructible restaurant objects.
item.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.

item.name: Jail
item.bestFor: Small-building fights and quick fire-extinguisher pickup
item.landmarks: Light-purple three-story house with a metal-bar jail cell, toilet, and bunk bed.
item.itemSpawns: Fire extinguisher outside the cell.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible objects.
item.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.

item.name: Convenience Store
item.bestFor: Soda-machine routes, throwables, and quick indoor scrambles
item.landmarks: Small store with front and side glass double doors, stocked shelves, boxes, and a counter.
item.itemSpawns: Fire extinguisher, trash can, and soda machine near the entrance.
item.hazards: Destroying shelves can cause a small lag spike.
item.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.

item.name: Comedy Club
item.bestFor: Voice-chat microphone interactions and tight indoor fights
item.landmarks: Single-floor stage house with microphone, speakers, and an interactable piano.
item.itemSpawns: Nep behind the speaker near the exit.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Usable microphone requires voice chat access.

item.name: Court
item.bestFor: Voice-chat speaker interactions and small-room fights
item.landmarks: Small white courthouse with microphones and speakers.
item.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Voice-chat access is needed to use the microphones.

item.name: Shenanigans Ball
item.bestFor: Store-to-store routes, escalators, sewer access, and fighting through the mall
item.landmarks: Mall beside Shinjuku Station with escalators, graffiti, JJS Book Store, Sorcerer Appliances, SorceWay, Joyful Jolly Sweets, and nearby sewer access.
item.itemSpawns: Some mall stores include small objects and hidden details, but no separate source-backed item route was strong enough for standalone rows.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible interiors.
item.specialRules: Minor stores are merged into this parent row because they are too thin as standalone map entries.

item.name: Bowling Alley
item.bestFor: Void-edge awareness and bowling-ball landmark routes inside the mall
item.landmarks: Bowling lanes, shoe shelves, counter, scoreboards, and imed balls.
item.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
item.hazards: All lanes end with a gap to the void.
item.specialRules: Kept separate from the mall because the lane gap is a clear hazard.

item.name: The Sewers
item.bestFor: Underground travel, item-spawn context, and fights with bridges, pillars, and pipes
item.landmarks: Access through the mall store hole or a Shinjuku Station wall route, plus hallways, stairs, bridges, pillars, bars, and a radio.
item.itemSpawns: Items page separates surface and underground spawns, making the sewers important for blue-dot underground routes.
item.hazards: No direct damage hazard listed; tight underground routes can trap movement.
item.specialRules: Do not touch the cheese is source flavor, not treated as a gameplay rule.

item.name: Space
item.bestFor: Secret exploration and height-limit curiosity
item.landmarks: Pitch-black space view with stars and Earth visible below.
item.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
item.hazards: No source-backed combat hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Reached by getting to a certain height; going higher only changes the Earth model's apparent size.

item.name: Tombs of the Star
item.bestFor: Duel practice where spacing matters more than public-map routes
item.landmarks: Small brown island in a white void with one tree.
item.itemSpawns: No public item spawns listed for Duels.
item.hazards: Void-edge awareness; no source-backed public item or train hazard.
item.specialRules: Duels can queue Casual or Ranked, then teleport teams into randomized arenas.

item.name: Sewers
item.bestFor: Duel practice in a tighter underground arena
item.landmarks: Large underground room with pipes, water, and sewer theming.
item.itemSpawns: No public item spawns listed for Duels.
item.hazards: No source-backed special hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Separate from the main-map sewers landmark.

item.name: Gym
item.bestFor: Duel practice in a cleaner indoor arena
item.landmarks: Basketball gym.
item.itemSpawns: No public item spawns listed for Duels.
item.hazards: No source-backed special hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Current Map page says it is likely based on Megumi Fushiguro versus Reggie Star.

item.name: Grass Field
item.bestFor: Straight duel practice with minimal landmark clutter
item.landmarks: Grass-textured baseplate above the void.
item.itemSpawns: No public item spawns listed for Duels.
item.hazards: Void around the baseplate.
item.specialRules: Listed as the original Duels map.

item.name: Detention Center
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with high/low platform pressure
item.landmarks: Old hall with a giant hole, raised platforms, lower water-covered area, and ladders back up.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: Large drop from platforms into the lower water area.
item.specialRules: Gamemodes page says SWP, SRC, FTT, FSD, EOJ, AMS, and SSP use large maps after the V1.76 FTT change.

item.name: Shipping Yard
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with container cover and open sightlines
item.landmarks: Stacked containers, cranes, trucks, forklifts, and a broad open yard.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: Source notes performance issues when heavy destruction occurs.
item.specialRules: Update log V1.70 to V1.61 says the Shipping Yard map was remade.

item.name: Roadside
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with long approach routes
item.landmarks: Road between tunnel entrances, broad off-road valley, trees, and a paved loop path.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed beyond open-map exposure.
item.specialRules: An older update temporarily removed Roadside, but the current Map page lists it as a Roulette map.

item.name: Shibuya Station (2)
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with broken station cover and platform movement
item.landmarks: Underground subway station split between clean and damaged sections.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: Broken floors and walls shape movement, but no special damage hazard is listed.
item.specialRules: Separate from Shibuya Station (1), which is a small-map entry.

item.name: Shibuya Crossing
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds that need more open city space
item.landmarks: Map page lists the row but does not provide a current description.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Update Log V1.50 says Shibuya Crossing was added as a large Roulette map.

item.name: Zenin HQ
item.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with compound-style borders
item.landmarks: Map page lists the row but does not provide a current description.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Update Log V1.50 says Zenin HQ was added as a large Roulette map, and V1.70 to V1.61 says its invisible borders were remade.

item.name: Shinjuku's Fallout
item.bestFor: Small-map Roulette rounds with ruined-building cover
item.landmarks: Destroyed city battlefield with low ruined buildings, road barriers, and small skyscraper easter eggs.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed beyond ruined cover.
item.specialRules: Update Log V1.50 to V1.41 says Shinjuku's Fallout was added as a small Roulette map.

item.name: Shibuya Station (1)
item.bestFor: Small-map Roulette rounds with escalator and platform transitions
item.landmarks: Station floor connected to elevated platforms with escalators and stairs.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Separate from Shibuya Station (2), which is a large-map entry.

item.name: Theater
item.bestFor: Small-map Roulette rounds in a stage-focused space
item.landmarks: Regular theater with a stage.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Added to Roulette with Construction Site before later large/small source labels were consistent.

item.name: Construction Site
item.bestFor: Small-map Roulette rounds with construction-site cover
item.landmarks: Map page lists the row but does not provide a current description.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: No source-backed hazard listed.
item.specialRules: Update Log V1.50 to V1.41 calls Construction Site a small Roulette map.

item.name: Old Map
item.bestFor: Understanding old guides and screenshots that do not match the current Shinjuku map
item.landmarks: Center camp, church, barn, police/fire stations, tower, cabins, hospital, and extra buildings.
item.itemSpawns: Old source notes mention dummies, vending machines, fire extinguishers, and building objects, but this is not current public-map routing.
item.hazards: Lacked barriers on map edges before it was replaced.
item.specialRules: Retired when the current main map replaced it in V1.03.

item.name: Icy Landmass
item.bestFor: Understanding older PFC references after the minigame was removed
item.landmarks: Floating ice block.
item.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
item.hazards: Slippery floor.
item.specialRules: Exclusive to PFC, which the V1.76 update log says was removed.
